questions.q: Where does an admin configure whether a connected email and calendar account syncs into Salesforce?
options: Email-to-Case Settings
The Object Manager's Feed Tracking page
Einstein Activity Capture's own Settings area under Setup
A permission set's System Permissions
questions.explain: Einstein Activity Capture has its own Settings node in Setup, separate from base Activity Settings, where an admin configures sync behavior.

questions.q: In the Review Sync Settings screen, what does the 'Direction' dropdown for Events control?
options: Which time zone events display in
Whether events sync one-way (e.g., Exchange to Salesforce) or both ways between the connected account and Salesforce
The default event duration
Which users are invited to synced events automatically
questions.explain: Direction controls the flow of sync data — commonly one-way from the connected calendar into Salesforce, so Salesforce doesn't overwrite a rep's personal calendar.

questions.q: What does the 'Don't Share' default activity sharing setting do?
options: Prevents synced activities from ever being created
Deletes synced activities after 30 days
Blocks Einstein Activity Capture from syncing emails entirely
Keeps synced activities private to their owner unless the user chooses to share one individually
questions.explain: 'Don't Share' is the more conservative default — other users won't see a synced activity on a record unless the owner explicitly shares it.

questions.q: Where do tasks, events, and synced emails all end up being visible together on a record?
options: The Activity Timeline component on the record
Only in a custom report, never on the record itself
Three separate related lists that never combine
The Setup Audit Trail
questions.explain: Regardless of how they were created, tasks, events, and synced emails converge into one chronological feed on the record's Activity Timeline.

questions.q: Which of the following is a base Activity Settings option (not an Einstein Activity Capture setting)?
options: Setting the sync direction for Contacts
Allowing users to relate multiple contacts to a single task or event
Choosing 'Share with Everyone' for synced activities
Enabling Email Insights
questions.explain: Relating multiple contacts to a task or event is part of the base Activity Settings page, distinct from the Einstein Activity Capture sync and sharing settings covered in this lesson.
